reason: Based on the provided repository description, package metadata, and API usage notes, the plugin’s primary purpose is user-facing peak/valley alerting: it visually indicates pricing phase status and sends reminders around transition times through local and external notifications. Its feature set is reminder-focused with supportive UI customization and host endpoints, rather than serving as a general development or data-processing tool.

summaries.zh: DSH 网页插件，用于按峰谷时段显示可配置的边缘状态效果，并在到达高峰/低峰前后按设置触发本地通知或外部渠道提醒。
summaries.en: A DSH web plugin that marks peak/valley periods in the UI and triggers scheduled reminders with customizable content through local notifications or external push channels.

capabilities: Push reminders via browser notifications or external messaging channels
Configurable lead-time scheduling for phase alerts
Customizable notification templates and channel settings
Host-side HTTP API for status/configuration and test/trigger actions
Web UI controls for reminder, border, and status behavior
